curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How long can a Jewish youth maintain an assumed German identity once he is brought into the inner ranks of the Hitler Youth?
curatedMovie.description: Separated from his family in the opening days of World War II, a young Jewish boy conceals his true background, masquerades as a German orphan, and is swept into the Nazi apparatus as an unlikely wartime hero.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful, and deeply engaged; a high-stakes historical drama best suited for focused solo viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Agnieszka Holland, this historical drama offers a gripping, morally fraught look at wartime survival where every encounter carries the risk of immediate discovery.
